about_short_description.short_description: Ever Loved helps people navigate the funeral process from end-to-end, reducing stress and lowering costs.

product.name: Memorial Websites
product.description: Online platforms to create and share memorial pages for deceased loved ones, including obituaries, photos, stories, and funeral event details.

product.name: Funeral Planning Tools
product.description: Guided online tools that help users plan funerals by mapping personal values to funeral decisions and generating customized checklists.

product.name: Funeral Provider and Product Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace listing funeral homes, cemeteries, hospices, and memorial products to help users find and compare providers and purchase funeral-related goods.

product.name: Memorial Fundraising
product.description: A service that enables users to set up online fundraisers to collect financial contributions for funeral and related expenses.

product.name: Post-Death Checklist and Task Management
product.description: An online checklist and task assignment tool that guides users through over 50 post-death tasks with instructions and progress tracking.
